emi.atouchofdarkness.info.fuel: Use any furnace fuel but a tool on a placed Lamp or Campfire, or click it onto a Lamp in your inventory: it adds %s times its furnace burn time. Holds at most: Campfire %s, Soul Campfire %s, Lamp %s, Soul Lamp %s.
emi.atouchofdarkness.info.relight: Relight a Spent Torch with flint and steel, a fire charge, or a lit Torch or Lamp in your other hand, or by using it at fire, lava or a lit campfire. It burns a quarter as long as a fresh Torch.
emi.atouchofdarkness.info.vanilla_lights: In your inventory, a vanilla torch, lantern or campfire turns into one that burns out: a Torch, a full Lamp switched on, or a Campfire.
emi.atouchofdarkness.info.nightbrand: Hold a single Spent Torch in the Dark for %s and it becomes a Nightbrand. Time out of the Dark doesn't reset it. One a day per player.
emi.atouchofdarkness.info.votive: Set a Lamp on a gold block and use a Torch on it: the Lamp becomes a Lampad, the gold her Votive. A Votive without a Lampad summons a new one the same way.
emi.atouchofdarkness.info.no_recipe: Vanilla's torches, lanterns, candles, campfires and other cheap lights can't be crafted. The vanillaLight config option brings their recipes back.
